questions.question: What is the distribution of the minimum of independent exponentials with rates $\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_n$?

questions.explanation: The minimum of independent exponentials with rates $\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_n$ is exponential with rate $\lambda_1+\cdots+\lambda_n$ (rates add).
